rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a material template for the later letter. Both are Kennedy letters transmitting legislation arising from the same March 9 housing message, and both frame the proposal through the paired objectives of meeting national housing needs and reversing urban deterioration. The child adapts that framing from C13's substantive housing-and-urban-improvement bill to legislation creating a cabinet department responsible for those fields. C03 and C02 share the transmission-letter structure and some phrasing, but their overlap is more routine and their substantive programs are unrelated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: draft legislation to carry out the recommendation in my March ninth message on housing and community development
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a bill including the principal legislative recommendations of this Administration for housing and urban improvement. These measures are intended to carry out the proposals set forth in my message to the Congress on March 9.
shared_material.explanation: The letters expressly derive their legislation from the same presidential message and describe it using closely corresponding housing-and-urban-development language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: preventing the appalling deterioration of many of our country's urban areas and rehabilitating the cities of our nation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: reverse the steady deterioration of our cities... halting the blanket of blight which has been spreading over our cities
shared_material.explanation: Both use urban deterioration as a principal justification, with the child adapting C13's deterioration-and-blight framing to the proposed department.

shared_material.child_excerpt: insuring the availability of adequate housing for all segments of our population
shared_material.parent_excerpt: meet the housing needs of millions of Americans... providing decent housing for all Americans
shared_material.explanation: Both pair urban rehabilitation with broadly available adequate housing, creating the same two-part policy rationale.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that prompt action can be scheduled on this important legislation and that the Congress will act favorably on the proposal.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope these proposals will have the early and serious consideration of the Congress
shared_material.explanation: The closing request for expedited congressional consideration follows the same functional placement and closely related formulation.
